entries.title: Psalms 64:4
segments: Shoot at him; speak violent and bitter words against him.

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: The wicked encourage each other in sin, and flatter themselves and one another that their evil deeds will never be brought to light.

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: They search out iniquities; devise wicked plans.

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments:
Their own tongue; their bitter words. 
 
The evils which the wicked seek to bring upon the righteous often fall upon themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 64:9
segments: Shall fear; fear the judgments of God.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments:
Shall glory; glory or rejoice in God, who has delivered them. 
 
Uprightness of heart is essential to joy in a holy God.
